title: Knowledge-Guided Synthetic Bug Feedback for LLM-Based Unit Test Generation
datasets: 172 Defects4J method tasks; historical KB from five Java bug sources
input_setting: correct-version code; buggy counterpart reserved for final evaluation
concept_hook: Historical bug → semantic mechanism + structural applicability → executable injected feedback. Rất gần concept direction.
limitation: No public source verified; fixed-input setting; substantial KB construction/injection cost. GPT-5.4 pipeline chưa được chạy. Không nhầm với paper KITE khác đã lưu trong repo.
